description: Create a data model in the workspace. Every field label (and description) is text per language code of the workspace: { en: "Title", pl: "Tytuł" }. Field types include select/multiselect (provide `options` as [{ value, label }] - the value is what records store), relation (link to another model via `relationTo` = the target model's slug + `relationType`), and object/list (nested `fields`/`itemFields`). Optional model-level config: slug, description, icon, color, displayField, defaultSort, statusField, `product` (commerce capability: enabled, priceField, skuField, inventoryField, variantAxes), `auth` (accounts: enabled, identityField, companyField for a B2B company link - a relation to a model with Company enabled; a field's `memberCanSet` opens it to the member on their own account and at sign-up - registration accepts only those fields, never password fields or the company field), `company` ({ enabled }: its records are the companies an accounts model links; a model is at most one of product, account (auth) or company), `uniqueFields` (field keys whose value must be unique - lets import_records update by that key) and `deliveryAccess` - a model is "none" (admin only) by default, so pass "public" when the user's app must read it through the delivery API. `urlPattern` (e.g. /p/{slug}) says where its records live on the storefront, so their `url` becomes a working link - ask the user for their route rather than inventing one.

acceptedTypes.description: For a 'media' field: allowed media kinds (empty = all).

defaultValue.description: Default value, always a string. It seeds only a field that holds one string, number or boolean - a structured type (media, multiselect, repeater, list, pageSelector, object, table, json) or a hasMany relation is refused on save.

description.description: Help text under the field, per language.

fields.description: For an 'object' field: nested field definitions.

hidden.description: Hide the field from admin forms (still stored on records).

itemFields.description: For a 'list' of objects: nested field definitions.

itemType.description: For a 'list' field: the type of each item.

label.description: The field's label per language code of the workspace: { en: 'Size', pl: 'Rozmiar' }. At least one language.

localized.description: Store this field's value per language: { en: '...', pl: '...' }. Only 'text', 'textarea', 'richText' and 'markdown' may be translatable - a translatable price or sku would corrupt the catalog and is rejected.

memberCanSet.description: On an accounts model: opens the field to the member - they may change it on their own account and send it at sign-up (registration accepts only these fields; password fields and the company field never, whatever the flag). Top-level fields only, never a hidden or company field. On the login field it opens the login change flow, on the password field the password change.

multiple.description: For a 'media' field: true = gallery, false = single.

options.description: Choices for a 'select' or 'multiselect' field: [{ value: 's', label: { en: 'Small' } }]. Required (non-empty) for those types; values must be distinct.

label.description: What the editor sees, per language: { en: 'Small', pl: 'Mały' }.

value.description: The stored value - what a record holds and filters match.

relationTo.description: For a 'relation' field: the slug of the model to link to (e.g. 'category', from list_models). Required for relation fields.

relationType.description: For a 'relation' field: cardinality. 'hasOne' = one linked record, 'hasMany' = many. If omitted, treated as 'hasOne'.

auth.description: Accounts config PATCH: omitted keys keep their stored values, null unlinks the company. enabled turns the model into an accounts (customer) model.

companyField.description: Relation field (hasOne) naming the customer's company; it must link a model with the Company capability enabled (company: { enabled: true }). null unlinks the company.

identityField.description: Email or text field that identifies the account (default 'email')

company.description: Company capability PATCH: an omitted enabled keeps the stored value. A model is at most one of product, account (auth) or company. Turning it off is refused while an accounts model's companyField links this model.

enabled.description: true makes the model's records companies an accounts model's companyField can link.

deliveryAccess.description: Who can read this model through the delivery API: "public" (any app with the workspace endpoint - required for a content API), "members" (signed-in site members only), "none" (admin only, the default).

displayField.description: Field key used as the record's display label in UI

product.description: Product capability config PATCH: omitted keys keep their stored values (defaults on first enable: skuField 'sku', priceField 'price', inventoryField 'inventory', variantAxes [], name/image/taxRate overrides null). A product is priced in the workspace's defaultCurrency through priceField; prices in additional currencies are set with set_product_currency_prices and set_product_variants, never through a field. The cart reads every product field through these roles - there is no per-cart field mapping. While the product is enabled, every role is graded against the key it resolves to on any call that changes product, fields, removeFields or displayField, so a fields-only update can be refused for a role it never named; a disabled product is not graded until it is enabled. Each role below names the types it accepts and when its field must exist. String-valued types: text, textarea, richText, markdown, color, url, email, select, radio, phone, link, file, form, hidden. A translatable field is one with localized: true on the model. E.g. {variantAxes: []} clears the axes without touching anything else.

imageField.description: Field key holding the product image the cart snapshots. null clears the override; unset it resolves to 'image'. The field it resolves to must be a media field, a list of media, or a text or url field. A set key must also exist; only the unset default may be absent.

inventoryField.description: Field key holding the stock count (default 'inventory'). The field must be a number field. A key other than the default 'inventory' must exist.

nameField.description: Field key holding the product name the cart shows. null clears the override; unset it resolves to the model's displayField, then 'name'. The key it resolves to must name an existing string-valued field - always, set or not.

priceField.description: Field key holding the unit price in major units - the number a merchant types, 49 = $49.00; the server converts to minor units when pricing (default 'price'). Volume tiers and ad-hoc order lines are minor units - do not mix the two. The field must be a number field. It must exist while variantAxes is empty; a key other than the default 'price' must exist regardless.

skuField.description: Field key holding the SKU (default 'sku'). The field must be string-valued and not translatable - the SKU is an identity, mirrored to one value per record and compared by equality. A key other than the default 'sku' must exist.

taxRateField.description: Field key holding the id of the tax rate (from the cart config) that applies to a record. null clears the override; unset it resolves to 'taxRate'. The field it resolves to must be string-valued and not translatable - the rate id is read from the record as stored, without resolving a locale. A set key must also exist; only the unset default may be absent.

variantAxes.description: Field keys used as variant axes (e.g. ['size','color']). Every axis must name a distinct existing select field on the model with at least one option. Pass [] to clear all axes.

slug.description: URL-safe slug (lowercase). Derived from name when omitted.

statusField.description: Enable record lifecycle states with allowed transitions

transitions.description: Allowed transitions: from one state to a set of states

uniqueFields.description: Keys of top-level text, email, url, phone or number fields whose value no two records may share (not translatable fields, not the product price/stock fields). Replaces the whole list; [] removes every constraint. Refused while existing records already share a value - the error lists them.

urlPattern.description: Where this model's records live on the storefront, appended to the site's public site URL, e.g. /p/{slug} or /{locale}/shop/{category.slug}/{slug}. Must start with /. Tokens: {fieldKey} (a visible text, number, date, select or radio field of this model), {relationField.fieldKey} (that field of the record a single relation links to) and {locale}. Unknown fields or bad token syntax are refused. null removes it.

name: create_model
title: Create model
